# Audit: the Mart's price box (Edit1) is empty until the player first picks
# an item or changes the quantity, since only RadioGroup1Click and
# SpinEdit1Change write it. After that, opening the Mart shows "0¥": FormShow's
# SpinEdit1.Value := 0 recomputes it when the quantity wasn't "0", and
# otherwise the last price was for a quantity of 0.
Money 30000
party 25 10
> start
> menu Actions > Buy Items
> text Form9.Edit1
text Form9.Edit1 ""
> click Form9.Button2
> menu Actions > Buy Items
> text Form9.Edit1
text Form9.Edit1 ""
> radio Form9.RadioGroup1 2
> text Form9.Edit1
text Form9.Edit1 "0¥"
> type Form9.SpinEdit1 3
> text Form9.Edit1
text Form9.Edit1 "9000¥"
> click Form9.Button2
> menu Actions > Buy Items
> text Form9.Edit1
text Form9.Edit1 "0¥"
> radio Form9.RadioGroup1 1
> text Form9.Edit1
text Form9.Edit1 "0¥"
> click Form9.Button2
> menu Actions > Buy Items
> text Form9.Edit1
text Form9.Edit1 "0¥"
> quit
exit 0
save unchanged
